raw_review_excerpt:
The S5 plan is well-grounded and near freeze-ready. It correctly identifies the gap in the V2 workflow (no live-validation gate between fix-feedback and compose-finalize), proposes a concrete single-node solution, has two properly scoped LBAs with verify commands, and Phase 99 uses real Archon/Codex smoke surfaces rather than invented harnesses. Two WARN-level issues: (1) P1-T1 edits the workflow YAML but no task regenerates the bundled-defaults generated file, which will cause a confusing content-mismatch failure during P2-T1 testing; (2) the e2e_report_manager.py flag surface (especially --notes-file) is invoked by the plan but was not verified to accept all six flags used. One NOTE: P99-T2's prerequisite contract declares a command_smoke with expected_exit_code 0 for a long-running dev server, which is a structural mismatch with the actual backgrounded command in Commands to Run.

Issues:
- 1. [WARN] Bundle regeneration step missing from execution plan
- 2. [WARN] e2e_report_manager.py flag surface not verified
- 3. [NOTE] P99-T2 prerequisite contract declares expected_exit_code 0 for long-running dev server
closure_verification: Round 1/3 — no prior-round issues to verify. All findings are first-round originals based on direct artifact inspection.

issues.title: Bundle regeneration step missing from execution plan
issues.details: P1-T1 edits .archon/workflows/defaults/archon-piv-loop-codex-v2.yaml. The bundled-defaults.test.ts (lines 52-71) asserts that BUNDLED_WORKFLOWS content matches on-disk YAML via bundled-defaults.generated.ts, which is produced by scripts/generate-bundled-defaults.ts (referenced at test line 33). No task in P1 or P2 runs the bundle regeneration (bun run check:bundled or the generator script). P1-T2's string assertions on BUNDLED_WORKFLOWS['archon-piv-loop-codex-v2'] and P2-T1's bun test run will hit a content-mismatch failure before any S5-specific assertion is even evaluated.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an explicit step in P1-T1 (after editing the YAML) or as a standalone sub-step before P1-T2: run the bundle generator (scripts/generate-bundled-defaults.ts or bun run check:bundled) so the generated file reflects the updated YAML before string assertions are added.

issues.title: e2e_report_manager.py flag surface not verified
issues.details: The plan invokes e2e_report_manager.py with six flags: --plan-path, --repo-root, --verdict, --backend-mode, --ui-mode, and --notes-file (P99-T2 only). The script was not inspectable during this review (read permission denied). If --notes-file is not a supported flag, P99-T2's evidence-recording command will fail at runtime. The plan treats this helper as a known-good contract but does not include a preflight verification of its CLI surface.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a verify step in P0-T3 or P99-T1: run python3 e2e_report_manager.py --help and confirm all six flags are accepted. Record the output as grounding evidence. If --notes-file is missing, either add it to the helper or adjust the P99-T2 command.

issues.title: P99-T2 prerequisite contract declares expected_exit_code 0 for long-running dev server
issues.details: The P99-T2 task_contract in the state file and plan has a command_smoke entry with command 'PORT=4000 bun run dev' and expected_exit_code 0. This is a long-running process that never exits 0 on its own. The actual Commands to Run section correctly backgrounds the server. This is a structural mismatch between the prerequisite contract schema and the operational reality.
issues.suggested_fix: Either adjust the prerequisite contract to use a daemon-appropriate kind (if supported), or change the command_smoke entry to a bounded health-check like 'PORT=4000 bun run dev & sleep 5 && curl -sf http://localhost:4000/' that actually terminates with exit 0.
